meta_description: A record of bushwalks around Mudgee, NSW: routes, maps, photos and tips.
lede: A record of bushwalks around Mudgee, from the Gardens of Stone to the Capertee and beyond. Each one has a route description, map, photos and what you need to know before you go.
hero_alt: Looking through a triangular sandstone tunnel towards ferns and forest
safety_text: Many of these walks are off-track and unmarked. Conditions change, so carry a map and compass or GPS, take plenty of water, tell someone your plans and check the [NSW National Parks alerts](https://www.nationalparks.nsw.gov.au/alert/state-alerts) before you go.
footer_right: Photos and route notes by the author
